Distribution and habitat. This species is only known from the type locality, Unnamed Cave 3 (Figs 1 J, 23 A), which is located about 7 km southeast of Donggan Town (Malipo County). This limestone cave has one steep downward semicircular entrance (about 2 m high and 4 m wide), approximately 200 meters in length, and extends horizontally. The location is far from agricultural fields and residential areas, and the cave interior remains pristine. All of the specimens were collected under stones in the deep zone (temperature around 14 ° C, humidity over 85 %).
